# Production Build (`dist`)

This directory contains the production-ready build of the frontend application.

It is generated by running `npm run build` using Vite. The contents of this folder can be deployed directly to static hosting services.

## Directory Structure

- **`assets/`**: Contains minified JavaScript and CSS files with content hashes.
- **`sounds/`**: Static sound assets copied from the `public` folder.
- `index.html`: The optimized entry point HTML.
